messages.content:
Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

today is thursday . i came home from a trip 3 days before the day after last monday . how many days have i been home ?

A. 1 day
B. 2 days
C. 7 days
D. 6 days
E. 10 days

message.content:
**D**

Last Monday was 6 days ago (Saturday). The day after that Monday was Tuesday; 3 days before Tuesday was the previous Saturday. From Saturday to today (Thursday) = 6 days.

ANSWER: D
message.reasoning_content: Today Thursday. Last Monday = 6 days ago (if today is Thursday, last Monday is previous week? Day after last Monday = last Tuesday, 3 days before = previous Saturday. From Saturday to Thursday: 6 days.
